## Silver Dragon, Very Old (CR 18)

**XP** 153,600  
 LG Gargantuan dragon (cold)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** dragon senses, fog vision; Perception +32; **Aura** cold (5 ft., 1d6 cold), frightful presence (270 ft., DC 27)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 35, touch 5, flat-footed 35 (-1 Dex, +30 natural, -4 size)  
 **hp** 287 (23d12+138)  
 **Fort** +19, **Ref** +14, **Will** +21  
 **DR** 15/magic; **Immune** acid, cold, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 29  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 250 ft. (poor); cloudwalking, graceful flight  
 **Melee** bite +31 (4d6+16/19–20), 2 claws +30 (2d8+11), tail slap +28 (2d8+16), 2 wings +28 (2d6+5)  
 **Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (60-ft. cone, DC 27, 18d8 cold), crush (4d6+16, DC 27), paralyzing breath, tail sweep (2d6+16, DC 27)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 23th; concentration +29)  

  
  At will—
  *control winds, detect evil, feather fall, fog cloud*
  
 **Spells Known** (CL 13th; concentration +19)  

  
  6th (5/day)—
  *greater dispel magic, heal*
  

  5th (7/day)—
  *break enchantment, flame strike* (DC 21)
  *[, plane shift](../../magic/spells/plane-shift.md)*
  

  4th (7/day)—
  *dimension door, freedom of movement, restoration, solid fog*
  

  3rd (7/day)—
  *cure serious wounds, dispel magic, hold person* (DC 19),
  *[wind wall](../../magic/spells/wind-wall.md)*
  

  2nd (8/day)—
  *augury, calm emotions* (DC 18),
  *cure moderate wounds, invisibility, web* (DC 18)
  

  **1st (**
  8/day)—
  *[alarm](../../magic/spells/alarm.md)*,
  *bless, divine favor, shield, true strike*
  

  0 (at will)—
  *detect magic, flare* (DC 16),
  *light, message, prestidigitation, read magic, stabilize, resistance, virtue

* Note: A silver dragon can cast cleric spells as arcane spells
  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 33, **Dex** 8, **Con** 23, **Int** 22, **Wis** 23, **Cha** 22  
 **Base Atk** +23; **CMB** +38; **CMD** 47 (51 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Critical Focus, Flyby Attack, Hover, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lighting Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Quicken Spell, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite)  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +22 (+24 Jump), Diplomacy +32, Fly +15, Heal +32, Intimidate +32, Knowledge (arcana, history, local, nobility) +32, Perception +32, Sense Motive +32, Spellcraft +32  
 **Languages** Auran, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Halfling, Giant, Terran  
 **SQ** change shape  

**Special Abilities**

 **Change Shape (Su)** A silver dragon can assume any animal or humanoid form 3/day as if using *polymorph*.  

 **Cloudwalking (Su)**
